method: Within-lecture review ranking: 60% best study-guide similarity, 25% direct quiz coverage weighted by the existing question priority, 15% direct essentials-guide reference; top 40% of sections per lecture.
interpretation: Must know identifies core review priorities. Scores are not probabilities of appearing on the exam.
source_material: Supplied Exam 1 study guide, lecture scripts, existing 208-question bank and essentials guide. No external exam dataset.
